240-969-5470-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
240-969-5470-8227.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Loot by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Loot ability, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

687-2921-5004--73.easyPrerequisites: The creature with persist or undying doesn't  have a -1/-1 or +1/+1 counter on it respective to its ability.
687-2921-5004--73.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Cathodion.
Cathodion triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing your persist/undying creature.
The creature's persist/undying ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield with a vigilance counter and the appropriate choice of a +1/+1 or -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Activate Tayam by paying {3}, removing  both counters from your persist/undying creature and one counter from another creature, causing yourself to mill three cards and return Cathodion from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1829-3968-4050-4078.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 4 or higher.
1829-3968-4050-4078.description:
Activate Chainer by paying {B}{B}{B} and 3 life, returning Grave Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Grave Titan enters, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing Grave Titan and the two Zombies, adding {B}{B}{B}
When Grave Titan and the Zombie tokens die, Vindictive Vampire triggers three times, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent for each trigger.
Repeat.

464-6590.easyPrerequisites: Fraying Sanity is attached to an opponent.
464-6590.description:
Cast Overture by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing an opponent to mill half their library, rounded down.
At the beginning of your end step, Fraying Sanity triggers, causing the opponent to mill cards equal to the number of cards put into their graveyard this turn.

4885-5078-5741-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1339-1832-2034-2403.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1832-2034-2403.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}
When the Insect dies, Moonlit Wake triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

277-3129-4365-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

3951-5703-5929-7824.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
3951-5703-5929-7824.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

129-1409-4742-6723.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

630-2366-4478-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
630-2366-4478-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Keeper of Progenitus triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

240-413-5223-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
When the Egg enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
When the Egg enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat from step 3.

1385-2034-4681-5170.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Zulaport Cutthroat trigger.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

232-1235-1309-4285.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Increasing Vengeance by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Salvager of Secrets.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Salvager of Secrets with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Salvager of Secrets tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Salvager of Secrets trigger, returning Increasing Vengeance from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

969-3490-4289-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
969-3490-4289-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2919-3490-4050-6823.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-3490-4050-6823.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-6096-6791.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6096-6791.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and General Kreat as attackers.
General Kreat triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, General Kreat triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-6096-6791.notes: After the first loop, General Kreat doesn't have to attack, since the Goblin token attacking will trigger it.

1168-1651-4426-5334-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1168-1651-4426-5334-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1168-1651-4426-5334-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Toggo triggers twice due to Roaming Throne, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

1274-2428-2541.description:
Activate Benthic Biomancer by paying {1}{U}, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to loot.
Horizon Chimera triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Repeat from step 2.
1274-2428-2541.notes: If Benthic Biomancer has a +1/+1 counter on it, you cannot use its adapt ability, and will need another way to put a counter on it. You can start the combo at steps 3/4 to accomplish this, or use any other method. This will also remove the mana requirement.

3557-5261-6587-6588.description:
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Moonmist without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Moonmist, transforming Ultimecia, Time Sorceress into Ultimecia, Omnipotent.
Ultimecia, Omnipotent triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Brago. Brago triggers, blinking Ultimecia, Omnipotent and causing it to re-enter the battlefield as Ultimecia, Time Sorceress.
Whenever Ultimecia, Time Sorceress enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to surveil 2.
Repeat each turn.

573-643-1399-1606.description:
Activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Gruul Turf.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

3918-4002-4222.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
3918-4002-4222.description:
Activate Trazyn using Sceptre of Eternal Glory's ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat.

1486-1753-4452-5475.notablePrerequisites: Rukarumel on the battlefield with "Dwarf" chosen.
1486-1753-4452-5475.description:
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Samut trigger, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat.
1486-1753-4452-5475.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

1251-1409-2933-5798.easyPrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator paired with Drowner of Hope.
1251-1409-2933-5798.description:
Activate Drowner of Hope by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Drowner of Hope trigger, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Drowner of Hope.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

822-3789-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Roar of the Kha is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
822-3789-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
822-3789-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using The Blackstaff of Waterdeep.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Roar of the Kha without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Roar of the Kha, untapping all creatures you control
Repeat from step 2.

1330-2615-3432.notablePrerequisites: Tree of Perdition does not have summoning sickness.
1330-2615-3432.description:
Activate Tree of Perdition, exchanging target opponent's life total with Tree of Perdition's toughness.
Cast Star of Extinction for {5}{R}{R}, destroying target land and dealing 20 damage to all creatures and planeswalkers.
Truefire Captain triggers, dealing 20 damage to target opponent.

2034-3249-4336.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, targeting Kobolds of Kher Keep.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep from graveyard by paying {0}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

224-1993-3147.notablePrerequisites: You control fewer than nine lands.
224-1993-3147.description:
Activate Budoka Gardener by tapping it, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Budoka Gardener
Repeat.
